name: request_get_info
description: Minimal valid request, no payload.

name: request_get_capabilities
description: Minimal valid request, no payload.

name: request_ping_echo
description: Request with a payload the PING handler must echo back.

name: response_unsupported_opcode
description: Synthetic ERROR response for an opcode that doesn't exist (999).

name: resync_after_garbage_prefix
description: Garbage bytes followed by a valid frame — parser must resync on magic and decode the trailing frame, incrementing magic_resyncs.

name: bad_crc
description: Valid header/payload, corrupted trailing CRC byte — must yield STATUS_BAD_CRC and not dispatch the opcode.

name: request_arm_outputs
description: ARM_OUTPUTS with an all-zero challenge (never valid against a real device — for wire-layout decode testing only) requesting GP0/GP1 as output with a 3000ms lease.

name: request_digital_write_masked
description: Drive GP0 high, GP1 low, leave the rest untouched.

name: request_digital_read
description: Read all 8 channels.

name: request_digital_capture_start
description: Start an unbounded capture at 5000 Hz.

name: request_digital_capture_read
description: Read 400 samples from offset 0 of capture_id=1.

name: event_digital_capture_complete
description: Unsolicited capture-complete EVENT for a bounded capture (id=2, 200/200 samples) — sequence=0 is the unsolicited-frame convention.

name: request_pwm_config
description: Enable PWM on channel 0 at 1000 Hz, 50% duty (channel must already be in the ARM_OUTPUTS armed mask on a real device).

name: request_spi_xfer
description: Mode 0 transfer at 100kHz, 4 bytes full-duplex.

name: request_spi_slave_config
description: Enable the SPI slave (GP12-15).

name: request_i2c_xfer
description: Write register pointer 0x00 to device 0x50, then read 4 bytes back (repeated start, combined write-then-read).

name: request_i2c_slave_config
description: Enable the I2C slave (i2c1) at address 0x42.

name: request_uart_config
description: Configure UART0 at 115200 baud, 8N1.

name: request_uart_write
description: UART_WRITE payload is the raw bytes to send, no wrapper struct.

name: request_uart_read
description: Read up to 64 bytes from the RX ring.

name: request_adc_scan_config
description: Start an unbounded 3-channel round-robin scan at 3000 Hz total.

name: request_adc_scan_read
description: Read 242 samples (max that fits one 512-byte frame at 2 bytes each) from offset 0 of scan_id=1.

name: event_adc_scan_complete
description: Unsolicited ADC block-ready EVENT for a bounded scan (id=3, 300 samples).
